en.purpose: To calculate the prognostic stage group for kidney cancer based on the TNM classification.
en.misuse: Not to be used for staging other types of cancer.

other_details.en: An assessment tool used to assign the stage group for kidney cancer tumors based on the UICC 8 TNM classification.

when: $gt0003|T - Primary tumor|==local::at0011|T1 - tumor ≤ 7 cm, limited to the kidney|||$gt0003|T - Primary tumor|==local::at0012|T1a - tumor ≤ 4 cm|||$gt0003|T - Primary tumor|==local::at0013|T1b - tumor > 4 cm but ≤ 7 cm|
$gt0004|N - Lymph nodes|==local::at0023|N0 - no regional lymph node metastasis|

$gt0003|T - Primary tumor|==local::at0014|T2 - tumor > 7 cm, limited to the kidney|||$gt0003|T - Primary tumor|==local::at0015|T2a - tumor > 7 cm but ≤ 10 cm|||$gt0003|T - Primary tumor|==local::at0016|T2b - tumor > 10 cm, limited to the kidney|
$gt0004|N - Lymph nodes|==local::at0023|N0 - no regional lymph node metastasis|

($gt0003|T - Primary tumor|!=null&&$gt0004|N - Lymph nodes|!=null&&$gt0005|M - Distant metastasis|==local::at0026|M1 - distant metastasis|)||($gt0003|T - Primary tumor|==local::at0021|T4 - tumor invades beyond Gerota fascia (including contiguous extension into the ipsilateral adrenal gland)|&&$gt0004|N - Lymph nodes|!=null&&$gt0005|M - Distant metastasis|==local::at0025|M0 - no distant metastasis|)

gt0001.description: An assessment tool used to assign the stage group for kidney cancer tumors based on the UICC 8 TNM classification.

gt0010.description: stage III:T3, N0, M0  OR T1-3, N1, M0;

gt0011.description: stage IV: Any T, Any N, M1 OR T4, Any N, M0.
